program.section_heading: Spanish - Associate in Arts for Transfer (ADT) - AA708 (CalGETC)
outcomes: Demonstrate critical thinking skills in Spanish by interpreting and articulating ideas, questions, opinions and information at the high-intermediate level, both orally and in writing.
Analyze the practices, products and perspectives of the Spanish-speaking countries and peoples throughout the world through a comparison of Hispanic cultures and their own.
